notes.content:

[b]Version 1.1.0	[/b]
[list]
[*] Exploding barrels
[*] 4 new staff
[*] 3 new dark areas
[*] 2 new weapons
[*] 2 new amulets
[*] New game object that allows you to recycle items into crystals.
[*] New mutator
[*] Bugs fixes
[/list]

notes.title: First update!
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3
[list]
 [*]New Mutator. The enemies health is halved.
 [*]Melee weapon range slightly increased
 [*]Different color for Exit (Map)
 [*]Armor stand is destroyable (50% drop chance, Iron Sword)
 [*]Crosshair is enabled by default
 [*]Minor graphic fixes and improvements
 [*]Minor bugs fixes
[/list]
